top_risks.title: Late Payment Fees
top_risks.explanation: This clause means you'll be charged 2% monthly interest if you're late with payments, and the provider can immediately stop working with you if you don't pay. Suggest negotiating a clear definition of what constitutes 'reasonable fees' or setting a cap on these charges to avoid unexpected costs.
